items.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomberg, The New York Times, and The Handbasket’s Marisa Kabas.During the meeting, Huang reportedly called claims that President Donald Trump was directly involved in his reinstatement — an idea publicly promoted by Trump himself — “completely untrue.” He added, “Don’t think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company,” according to Kabas.Along with attempting to dismiss Trump’s involvement, Huang reportedly said he also didn’t return because he was a “tech bro” who was “above the law” or “above the code of conduct.” He added that, “no story has been more tortured than this one in human history,” Kabas reports. Instead, Huang said the Nvidia board “evaluated the entire situation,” while receiving assurance from the government that he posed no national security threat, according to the NYT.Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on November 12th, following reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two employees, including vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell. On Monday, Nvidia announced that it had reinstated Huang as CEO, president, and member of the board — a decision the White House said Trump was “totally involved in.” Trump also confirmed that he worked with Vice President JD Vance and other officials to bring Huang back. A swath of tech leaders, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and former White House AI czar David Sacks, were also in favor of Huang’s return.RelatedWelcome to elite impunity, Jensen HuangTrump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen HuangHow Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO againIn a post on Truth Social, Trump said that the government “has no reason to believe” Huang’s return poses a risk to national security, adding that the US attorney general “does not possess evidence” that he engaged in “unlawful conduct.” Nvidia is still facing an investigation over its accounting practices, according to Reuters. The company is also carrying out its own internal investigation surrounding reports that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot. Huang is set to testify before Congress on December 1st to answer questions about national security concerns, and Democrats are already planning to press Huang about his return, as well as Trump’s involvement.Even after all this, Huang reportedly said he “doesn’t believe in succession planning.” He also acknowledged that he violated Nvidia’s code of conduct, adding that he is attending therapy daily, Bloomberg reports. “I made some terrible mistakes,” Huang said, according to the NYT. “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and of course, I hurt all of you.”

items.titleZh: 据报道，黄仁勋告诉英伟达员工，特朗普让他重新受聘的说法“不属实”
items.descriptionZh:
据Bloomberg、纽约时报和The Handbasket记者Marisa Kabas报道，英伟达CEO黄仁勋在回归公司后的首次全员大会上向员工道歉，并试图与“白宫和科技领袖帮助他拿回职位”的叙事保持距离。会上，黄仁勋称美国总统特朗普直接参与其复职的说法“完全不真实”——尽管特朗普本人曾公开宣传这一说法。他还表示，“不要以为政治在公司中起了作用。我们是最不政治化的公司。”黄仁勋同时否认自己是因为“科技兄弟”身份、“凌驾于法律”或“凌驾于行为准则”而回归，并称“人类历史上没有哪个故事比这个更被扭曲”。据纽约时报报道，黄仁勋说英伟达董事会“评估了整个情况”，同时政府向他保证其不构成国家安全威胁。

背景是：黄仁勋于11月12日辞去英伟达CEO职务，此前有报道称他与一名被指为中国间谍的人以及两名员工存在婚外情，其中包括医疗健康副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔。周一，英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋的CEO、总裁和董事会成员职务。白宫称特朗普“完全参与”了这一决定；特朗普也确认他与副总统JD·万斯及其他官员合作促成黄仁勋回归。包括特斯拉CEO埃隆·马斯克、Epic Games CEO蒂姆·斯威尼和前白宫AI事务负责人大卫·萨克斯在内的多位科技领袖也支持黄仁勋回归。特朗普在Truth Social上称，政府“没有理由相信”黄仁勋回归会构成国家安全风险，并称美国司法部长“没有证据”证明他从事“非法行为”。

报道还指出，英伟达仍面临对其会计实践的调查，公司也在围绕黄仁勋是否为一桩中国间谍阴谋目标展开内部调查。黄仁勋将于12月1日赴国会作证，回答国家安全关切；民主党人已计划就他的回归以及特朗普的参与进行追问。黄仁勋还称自己“不相信继任计划”，并承认违反了英伟达行为准则，每天接受治疗。据纽约时报报道，他说：“我犯了一些可怕的错误。我对Lori不忠，我伤害了我的孩子，当然也伤害了你们所有人。”该事件本身不涉及芯片架构或性能参数，但英伟达作为AI算力核心供应商，其CEO人事、合规与国家安全审查交织，可能影响投资者信心、政府关系、公司治理及国会审查节奏，12月1日听证会成为观察政策风险的关键节点。

这篇来自Tom's Hardware的2026年黑五显卡促销报道指出，全球AI基础设施建设的持续扩张正在挤压消费级GPU供应，2026年显卡价格不断走高，行业领袖还预计价格将继续上涨。在此背景下，黑五促销只能被视为“相对当前高价的低点”，而非回到建议零售价。文章称，接近MSRP的显卡在2026年末已基本成为过去，部分产品即使打折，其性价比仍低到不值得推荐；如果用户需要升级GPU，或希望在《GTA VI》PC版发布前提前装机，现在可能是未来数年里相对较低的价格窗口。报道的促销清单覆盖Nvidia、AMD和Intel，并强调AMD与Intel显卡的性价比整体好于Nvidia产品，但RTX系列仍有一些优惠；热门好价会很快售罄，清单会全天更新。

从技术与产品背景看，清单涉及Nvidia RTX 50系列（Blackwell架构、支持DLSS 4.5功能集）、AMD Radeon RX 9000系列（RDNA 4架构）和Intel Arc B系列（Battlemage架构）。这些产品的差异主要体现在分辨率定位、显存容量和超分辨率/帧生成等特性上：RTX 5060面向1080p主流游戏，RTX 5060 Ti 8GB在1080p和1440p光栅化游戏中性能更高；RTX 5070面向1440p DLSS游戏，RTX 5070 Ti定位高端发烧友，RTX 5090则是顶级旗舰但溢价极端。AMD方面，RX 9070 GRE主打1080p/1440p较强性能，RX 9070 16GB可借助超分探索4K，RX 9070 XT是RDNA 4最快型号，适合高帧率1440p和4K。Intel Arc B570 10GB被称为2026年最值得买的最低端卡之一，Arc B580则配备12GB显存并采用Battlemage架构。

具体价格对比方面，报道列出多款代表性促销：Zotac RTX 5060从519.99美元降至439.99美元，省80美元（15%）；PNY RTX 5060为449美元；Gigabyte RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从519.99降至479.99美元（省8%）；Zotac RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从529.99降至499.99美元；MSI RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从549.99降至509.99美元；Gigabyte RTX 5070 12GB从939.99降至839.99美元；Asus RTX 5070 Ti OC为1400美元；Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090从7189.99降至6649.99美元，省540美元并送B650主板，但仍超过MSRP三倍多。AMD方面，ASUS RX 9070 GRE从826.99降至699.99美元（省15%）；Gigabyte RX 9070 GRE从773.99降至719.99美元；Gigabyte RX 9070 16GB从991.99降至814.99美元（省177美元）；Asus RX 9070 XT从1144.99降至979.99美元（省14%）；Sapphire RX 9070 XT从1112.99降至989.99美元；ASRock Steel Legend RX 9070 XT为999.99美元并限时送360mm一体水冷；Gigabyte RX 9070 XT为1034.99美元。Intel方面，ASRock Arc B570 10GB OC从307.49降至279.99美元（省9%），需领页面优惠券；ASRock Challenger Arc B580从370.99降至329.99美元（省11%），并送ASRock 360mm AIO和两个游戏兑换码。

文章还给出黑五选购GPU的实用维度：先确定目标分辨率和画质设置，低端预算卡可在1080p中画质运行，高画质需至少中端卡，2K高设置和4K则需更高阶产品；再确定可接受的帧率，30fps通常是最低可玩线，60fps算不错，电竞需求则希望合理设置下超过100fps；同时检查电源功率是否足够，可用Newegg电源计算器等工具估算，电源不足需换电源或换卡；最后确认机箱空间，小机箱要核对显卡长度与机箱 clearance。整体来看，这篇报道反映的核心影响是：AI算力需求正在重塑消费级GPU市场供需，导致显卡价格长期高位、旗舰卡溢价严重，而黑五促销成为玩家在涨价周期中相对有限的升级窗口；应用场景覆盖1080p主流游戏、1440p高刷、4K超分游戏以及电竞和内容创作等，但购买时需更重视分辨率、帧率、电源和机箱兼容性，避免为短期折扣买入性价比过低的产品。

items.content: Jensen Huang is partying it up in Ibiza. In a video with nearly 6 million views on Instagram, the former CEO of Nvidia is dancing in a crowded club, champagne glass in hand, still wearing his signature black leather jacket. Suddenly, from behind him, Alice Huang — the Chinese technology executive and suspected spy he had an affair with, sparking congressional investigations and his resignation from the chipmaking company he cofounded — appears. She puts her hand on his shoulder and he wraps his arm around her waist as they begin dancing together. The video’s caption reads “Honey Trap Final Boss. #inthemoodforlove.”Of course, it’s AI-generated. This Instagram Reel is one of hundreds of AI deepfakes featuring Huang, his wife Lori, Alice, and sometimes Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, Kimberly Powell (the second of three reported affair partners). In this case, Huang is being swapped into an existing meme called “Ibiza Final Boss.” The original video featured a British construction worker with a bowl cut dancing in exactly the same way, minus a woman sidling up to him. Other viral AI hits include Huang in a scene from The Office, Huang in the music video for George Michael’s “Careless Whisper,” and Huang as the former Astronomer CEO who got caught in an affair with one of his employees by the jumbotron at a Coldplay concert last summer. Even the rapper 50 Cent posted an AI edit of his “P.I.M.P.” music video, now featuring Huang with some flashy silver accessories.Unlike deepfake pornography or election disinformation, these AI videos aren’t necessarily intended to harm or mislead people. They’re memes making fun of Huang’s cheating scandal and its global implications, created with AI technology that in many cases relies heavily on Nvidia’s tech stack: video diffusion models running on the Nvidia GPUs that power much of the modern generative AI industry. “It’s ironic that without Nvidia generating millions of these AI memes ... would not be possible,” reads one of the top comments on the Ibiza deepfake. “In some sense, Jensen is making Nvidia richer by his own scandal.” The comment was punctuated by multiple cry-laughing emoji.As it turns out, Huang may benefit, too. On Monday, the Nvidia board announced he was reinstated as president, CEO, and board director following “a series of discussions and meetings” and “input from senior levels of the United States government.” Nvidia’s stock has since surged, and new AI Huang memes cast him in a victorious light. One variation swaps him into a scene from The Wolf of Wall Street, announcing “I’m not leaving” to a crowd of cheering men that has been edited to include AI versions of Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Mark Zuckerberg.RelatedWelcome to elite impunity, Jensen HuangTrump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen HuangWhile the saga continues, many social media users are finding the humor in these Huang deepfakes, and their creators are churning out variations to meet the sudden demand. The Instagram account behind the Ibiza one has made three Huang deepfakes so far, all remakes of the same scene. Another version features Powell dancing with him, and the third one shows a sea of young women in bikini tops and shorts surrounding Huang, who lifts his champagne up in celebration. Each has accrued millions of views.“His story has just come at the best time for ai creators and a terrible time for him,” wrote the account behind the Ibiza videos in a direct message to The Verge. “Everyone was doing him. Most I’ve seen anyone AI-ed.”This deepfake creator identified himself as a 40-year-old man from Melbourne, Australia, but wouldn’t share his real name. He says he has spent “thousands” on AI video generation, using models like TikTok developer ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 and Alibaba’s Wan 3. These, along with other AI tools like Google’s Nano Banana, help power the ecosystem of deepfakes.He said his Instagram page has been going “super viral” in the past two weeks, thanks to the Ibiza meme format. He has nearly 100 million views on various iterations of it featuring different celebrities. The Huang ones are among the most popular, alongside versions featuring Elizabeth Holmes and Amanda Seyfried playing her in the hit Nathan Fielder documentary You Can See Everything.“I wanted to elevate the content and know that putting what is happening in the news ... would get traction,” he wrote. “Always wanted to be a filmmaker but this technology is beyond whatever I imagined was possible.”As generative AI has taken hold of the internet in recent years, a lot of the resulting viral content has been disparaged as “AI slop.” Hollywood productions, mainstream artists, and even local businesses have been maligned for using (or appearing to use) AI in their advertisements and final cuts. Video trends like putting sexy AI fruit characters in Love Island parodies racked up millions of views online but failed to deliver any real cultural momentum. The ubiquity of the Huang deepfakes and the relative lack of blowback from AI critics may indicate that the future of AI-generated content is similar to the rest of meme culture: If the topic’s trending, people will engage with something, even if it’s following the same formula as the slop. That an AI tech titan’s own indiscretions are inspiring this latest evolution in deepfakes is just the sardonic cherry on top.“It’s not that we’re inundated in deepfakes of Trump being like ‘Nuclear war tomorrow,’ like the way it was framed as the big problem,” says misinformation researcher Abbie Richards. “Instead, it just feels like there is so much slop to push through to have any grounding in reality.”The AI memes of Huang and other public figures don’t feel as sinister as other forms of AI disinformation and misinformation, mainly because of how goofy they are. It’s hard to imagine anyone falling for a “Gangnam Style” parody or any serious implications if they did. But these deepfakes are still eerily realistic, as one comment on the Seyfried Ibiza variation pointed out: “All jokes aside, is anyone else finding it increasingly alarming that AI is capable of this?”Even the creator behind the Ibiza AI videos thinks “someone will try and clamp down because it’s getting outta control.” But in the meantime, he’s looking for ways to monetize his newfound virality. Despite his significant financial outlay, he says he hasn’t made any money yet, besides getting “gifted $3 on a reel once.”While Instagram has started to invite some creators to earn direct payouts from views on their Reels, the account behind the AI “Careless Whisper” parody featuring Huang told The Verge that “the way to earn is through creating content for clients and companies after gaining attention on social media.” This AI creator, who declined to share any identifying information, wrote in a direct message that they receive dozens of requests from new and returning clients for AI commissions every time they go viral, “which is quite often.” In addition to Huang deepfakes, some of their most viral AI edits feature Tobey Maguire’s Spider-Man as a rapper.The Ibiza AI meme creator has worked with one celebrity brand so far, belonging to the Irish mixed martial artist Conor McGregor. Four months ago, McGregor launched an energy drink called MAC Energy, and the company requested an AI Ibiza meme showing McGregor dancing with a can of it. The creator complied, and the post exists as a collaboration between the two Instagram pages, but it isn’t labeled as an advertisement and he says he didn’t ask for any money in return.“I just did it because it was a good opportunity for my page,” he says.It seems like the entity that stands to reap the biggest reward from viral Huang deepfakes is Instagram itself and the other social media sites where creators are posting them. And these humorous AI edits are technically allowed on Meta platforms, as long as creators disclose that they’re AI-generated. Meta didn’t respond to a request for comment by publication time.But there are other considerations besides profitability. Many of these AI memes hinge on sexist portrayals and racist stereotypes as the joke. Asian American women in Silicon Valley have reported an uptick in microaggressions revolving around “honeypot” and “Chinese spy” allegations. And when it comes to Powell and the other Nvidia employee who Huang reportedly had a relationship with, the workplace power dynamic at play has faded into the background of mockery.The more troubling dynamics of Huang’s affairs have faded into the background of mockery“Even though we know that he was wielding his power to have inappropriate relationships with his subordinates and his employees, it’s still like ‘LOL, let’s make an AI deepfake of him at the office,’” says Josh Lora, a writer and creator who has a popular TikTok series about the role of cheating scandals in American culture. “Why aren’t we having a real conversation about the effects of this on women, the effects of this workplace on women, especially 10 years after #MeToo?”The apparent lack of interest from major social media companies to stem the flow of this kind of disparaging AI content isn’t surprising to misinformation expert Richards, even as some tech CEOs, like Elon Musk, called for Huang’s reinstatement and cast doubt on the reporting against him. If Huang memes are truly in vogue, that may be worth more to the AI industry than his dignity.“I think that they are invested in the widespread adoption of AI,” she says. “So anything with AI going viral and appearing to be popular and liked by the public probably, in their mind, benefits them.”With Huang back as CEO, the message couldn’t be clearer: For him, the consequences of his affairs were temporary, including whatever humiliation stemmed from the AI memes. Ultimately, all any of it meant was more power for Nvidia and more power for Jensen Huang.

items.titleZh: 黄仁勋深度伪造视频成为热门的新型AI垃圾内容
items.descriptionZh:
2025年，英伟达联合创始人兼CEO黄仁勋因与华裔科技高管Alice Huang的婚外情丑闻辞去CEO职务，该事件引发国会调查，并牵出他与包括英伟达医疗健康副总裁Kimberly Powell在内的多名女性的关系。然而，这场丑闻在社交媒体上催生了一个意想不到的现象：大量以黄仁勋为主角的AI深度伪造视频迅速病毒式传播，成为互联网迷因文化的新宠。

在Instagram上，一段将黄仁勋换脸至“Ibiza Final Boss”迷因的视频获得近600万次观看。视频中，身着标志性黑色皮夹克的黄仁勋在拥挤的夜店中手持香槟跳舞，Alice Huang从身后出现，两人相拥共舞，配文写着“蜜罐终极BOSS #inthemoodforlove”。这显然是AI生成的。类似的深度伪造作品还有数百个，将黄仁勋置入《办公室》剧集场景、乔治·迈克尔的《Careless Whisper》音乐录影带，甚至模仿去年夏天天文学家CEO在酷玩乐队演唱会上被大屏幕拍到婚外情的名场面。说唱歌手50 Cent也发布了将黄仁勋换脸至其《P.I.M.P.》MV的AI编辑版本。

这些AI视频并非深度伪造色情或选举虚假信息，其目的不在于伤害或误导，而是以戏谑方式嘲讽黄仁勋的出轨丑闻及其全球影响。讽刺之处在于，这些迷因的制作高度依赖英伟达自身的AI技术栈——视频扩散模型运行在英伟达GPU上，而GPU正是支撑现代生成式AI产业的核心硬件。Ibiza深度伪造视频下的一条高赞评论写道：“讽刺的是，没有英伟达生成数百万个这样的AI迷因……这一切都不可能实现。某种意义上，Jensen通过自己的丑闻让英伟达更富有了。”

技术层面，这些深度伪造视频主要依托字节跳动开发的Seedance 2.5、阿里巴巴的Wan 3以及谷歌的Nano Banana等AI视频生成模型。一位来自澳大利亚墨尔本的40岁创作者（不愿透露真实姓名）向The Verge表示，他在AI视频生成上已花费“数千美元”，其Instagram账号过去两周因Ibiza迷因格式而“超级病毒式传播”，不同名人版本的累计观看量接近1亿次。黄仁勋系列是最受欢迎的内容之一，与伊丽莎白·霍姆斯及其在Nathan Fielder纪录片中的扮演者阿曼达·塞弗里德版本并列。

周一，英伟达董事会宣布，经过“一系列讨论和会议”并“听取美国政府高层意见”后，恢复黄仁勋的总裁、CEO及董事会董事职务。英伟达股价随后飙升，新的AI黄仁勋迷因也转向“胜利叙事”——其中一个版本将他换脸至《华尔街之狼》场景，对着欢呼的人群宣布“我不走了”，人群中被编辑加入了唐纳德·特朗普、埃隆·马斯克和马克·扎克伯格的AI形象。

这一现象引发了关于AI生成内容文化意义的讨论。近年来，生成式AI产出的病毒内容多被贬为“AI垃圾”，好莱坞制作、主流艺人乃至本地企业因使用或疑似使用AI而遭受批评。但黄仁勋深度伪造的广泛传播及AI批评者的相对沉默，或许表明AI生成内容的未来与迷因文化的其余部分并无二致：只要话题在热搜上，人们就会参与互动，哪怕内容遵循的是同样的“垃圾公式”。

错误信息研究员Abbie Richards指出：“问题不在于我们被特朗普‘明天打核战争’之类的深度伪造淹没——那不是被框定的大问题。相反，问题在于要穿透太多垃圾内容才能触及现实。”这些AI迷因因其荒诞搞笑而显得不那么险恶，很难想象有人会真的相信一个“江南Style”恶搞视频。但正如一位评论者在塞弗里德版Ibiza视频下所言：“玩笑归玩笑，难道只有我觉得AI能做到这种事越来越令人不安吗？”

更深层的问题在于，许多AI迷因以性别歧视和种族刻板印象为笑点。硅谷亚裔美国女性报告称，围绕“蜜罐”和“中国间谍”指控的微侵犯有所增加。而当涉及Powell及其他据报与黄仁勋有关系的英伟达员工时，职场权力动态在嘲讽中悄然隐退。作家兼创作者Josh Lora在其关于出轨丑闻在美国文化中作用的TikTok系列中表示：“尽管我们知道他利用权力与下属和员工发生不当关系，大家的反应仍然是‘哈哈，做个他在办公室的AI深度伪造吧’。为什么我们不认真讨论这对女性的影响、对职场女性的影响，尤其是在#MeToo十年之后？”

社交媒体巨头对此类贬损性AI内容的传播缺乏干预兴趣，这并不令Richards意外——即便马斯克等科技CEO曾呼吁恢复黄仁勋职务并质疑针对他的报道。如果黄仁勋迷因真的流行，这对AI行业而言可能比他的尊严更有价值。“我认为他们投资于AI的广泛采用，”她说，“所以任何AI内容病毒式传播、显得受公众欢迎和喜爱，在他们看来可能都有利于自己。”

在变现方面，Ibiza AI迷因创作者迄今仅与爱尔兰综合格斗选手康纳·麦格雷戈的能量饮料品牌MAC Energy合作过一次——四个月前该品牌要求制作一个麦格雷戈手持饮料罐跳舞的AI Ibiza迷因，帖子以两个Instagram账号合作形式发布，但未标注为广告，创作者称未收取任何费用，“只是觉得对我的页面是个好机会”。另一位制作黄仁勋版《Careless Whisper》恶搞视频的创作者表示，变现途径是在社交媒体获得关注后为客户和公司创作内容，每次病毒式传播后都会收到数十个新老客户的AI委托请求。Instagram已开始邀请部分创作者从Reels观看量中直接获得分成，但Meta未回应置评请求。

随着黄仁勋重返CEO岗位，信息再清晰不过：对他而言，婚外情的后果是暂时的，包括AI迷因带来的任何羞辱。归根结底，这一切只意味着英伟达和黄仁勋本人获得更多权力。

items.title: Jensen Huang confessed to more affairs before the board reinstated him as Nvidia CEO, report claims
items.description: Jensen Huang admitted to more affairs than the two that Nvidia's board members were already aware of before they agreed to let him return to the company as CEO, President, and board member, amid reports that one of the women involved is a Chinese spy.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following the news that Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has returned to the company as CEO a little more than a week after he resigned from the role, it's now believed that he admitted to additional extra-marital affairs beyond the two that were already known. The admission came during an hours-long meeting with Huang as Nvidia's board members discussed him potentially coming back to a company he left in disarray when he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The woman, Alice Huang, worked for Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer that is now under criminal investigation over its possible involvement in the smuggling of export-controlled Nvidia AI chips into China. Now, with Huang back in the top job at Nvidia, a WSJ report claims that the company's board rehired him despite the revelation that his affairs outnumbered the two already reported.The report details a November 22 meeting in which Huang and the Nvidia board sat down to discuss his return. Huang told the board that there were more affairs than those it already knew about, with people with knowledge of the discussions saying that he was contrite about his behavior. Then, after the board explained to Huang that it was important that he be honest and candid after at least one affair with an Nvidia employee, it was agreed that the best thing for the company would be for Huang to return. Huang has confessed to being unfaithful to his wife, Lori, reportedly carrying on an affair with Megaspeed's Alice Huang and Nvidia's VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. The report explicitly states Huang admitted to multiple further affairs, bringing the total of known instances to at least four.The company said its board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang. It's unclear whether its decision was affected by Nvidia's 24% stock price fall following Huang's affair scandal first broke. President Trump also stated he heavily lobbied for Huang's return, personally dialling in to an Nvidia board meeting to persuade the company to reinstate him.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: “I’m terribly sorry for putting all of you through all of this,” Huang reportedly said in a video of his return to the Nvidia offices. “I’ve made some very terrible mistakes, and I’m going to work on coming back.”Huang's return to Nvidia came after a week of uncertainty for the company. Calls for his return were made by everyone from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to U.S. President Trump. The latter was very vocal in his stance on Huang and has since taken the credit for Nvidia's decision to reinstate him. This came after he initially called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take the reins of the company. items.titleZh: 报道称，黄仁勋在董事会恢复其英伟达CEO职务前承认了更多婚外情
items.descriptionZh:
据 Tom's Hardware 报道，Nvidia 创始人黄仁勋在辞任 CEO 一周多后重返公司，并在此过程中向董事会承认了此前未被披露的更多婚外情。报道称，Nvidia 董事会曾与黄仁勋举行长达数小时的会议，讨论其回归可能性；黄仁勋在会议上表示，已知的两起婚外情之外还有更多情况，并对自己的行为表示悔意。知情人士称，董事会向黄仁勋强调，在至少与一名 Nvidia 员工存在婚外情后，坦诚和直率尤为重要，但最终认为让他回归最符合公司利益。报道还称，黄仁勋已承认对妻子 Lori 不忠，涉及的已知对象包括 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang 以及 Nvidia 医疗保健副总裁 Kimberly Powell，并进一步承认多起婚外情，使已知总数至少达到四起。

公司表示，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职务。报道称，目前尚不清楚这一决定是否受到婚外情丑闻首次曝光后 Nvidia 股价下跌 24% 的影响。文章还称，美国总统特朗普曾亲自致电 Nvidia 董事会会议，力劝公司让黄仁勋回归，并公开表示自己对此事进行了大力游说；SpaceX CEO 马斯克等人也曾呼吁黄仁勋回归。特朗普此前一度呼吁由前苹果 CEO Tim Cook 接手 Nvidia。黄仁勋在回归 Nvidia 办公室的视频中表示：“我非常抱歉让大家经历这一切。我犯了一些非常严重的错误，我会努力回来。”

从技术层面看，这篇报道没有披露新的芯片架构、制程、算力或能效参数，也没有产品创新发布；其核心是 Nvidia 的领导层治理、个人丑闻与 AI 芯片出口合规风险。报道特别提到，Alice Huang 所在的 Megaspeed 是 Nvidia 客户，目前因可能参与将受出口管制的 Nvidia AI 芯片走私到中国而接受刑事调查。黄仁勋回归后的首批公开行动之一，是于 12 月 1 日出席美国众议院外交事务委员会，就其与 Alice Huang 的关系以及受进口管制 AI 芯片流入中国的问题回答质询。该事件因此不仅是公司治理和投资者信心问题，也涉及美国对华 AI 芯片出口管制、客户合规审查和供应链追溯等敏感议题。

items.title: Trump pressured Nvidia to bring Jensen back, called into board meeting to push reinstatement, reports claim
items.description: Nvidia's crashing stock market prices is threatening to take down the entire market with it, which is why President Donald Trump decided to intervene and steady the situation.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The Nvidia board has reinstated Jensen Huang as the company’s CEO just 11 days after he resigned, a move that, although it had strong support from both employees and supporters, had surprised many. While the company’s board of directors voted unanimously to bring the founder back, it seems that this decision was pushed along by pressure from Washington. According to CNN, President Donald Trump, alongside Vice President JD Vance and several members of his cabinet, spent the weekend talking to industry insiders, investors, and even to the board itself to get Jensen back as the chief of Nvidia.“I’ve been speaking to the board directly and indirectly, and I felt very strongly about it,” Trump said in an interview with CNBC. “I think we have one of our great stars back in play.” Nvidia’s stock price took a beating when Jensen Huang admitted to the affairs, and his future at the company was in question. It went from bad to worse when he finally resigned on November 12, with the rest of the market following. This has brought concerns that Jensen’s downfall would drag Nvidia and the economy with him, which could potentially turn into a catastrophe as the AI bubble pops.The President said that bringing Jensen back as the CEO of Nvidia would be the only solution to this conundrum. True enough, Nvidia stock prices shot up to around $165 after Jensen’s reinstatement — a more than 25% rally from its previous close of around $130. “It’s a rocket ship going in the right direction, and it’s taking the whole market,” the president added. “It could be that there’s never been anything like it.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Despite the seemingly positive impact of Jensen Huang’s return to the company, Trump’s decision to intervene in the inner workings of a private institution has raised apprehension among politicians, even those from his own party. The biggest concerns raised include the Nvidia CEO’s involvement in national security issues, including his affair with a suspected Chinese spy, the billions of dollars’ worth of advanced Nvidia chips that have been allegedly smuggled despite the government’s export controls, and the fact that the President assured the Nvidia board that his administration does not believe that Jensen is a threat to national security and that he also was not facing any criminal charges, despite ongoing investigations. People also raised questions about the White House’s influence on the board of directors of a private company, something that was characterized as “an unprecedented campaign.”Trump’s push for Jensen Huang’s return at Nvidia is inherently risky, with the president himself saying that he had consulted Attorney General Todd Blanche and Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton about it. He said that they’ve been studying the issue for quite some time and that they had found nothing wrong, especially as Trump said that he can’t have anyone indicted after making the recommendation. items.titleZh: 报道称特朗普施压英伟达让黄仁勋回归，并致电董事会会议推动其复职
items.descriptionZh:
据Tom's Hardware报道，英伟达董事会在黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）辞去CEO仅11天后，一致投票决定让其回归。该决定虽得到员工和支持者强烈支持，但仍令外界意外；报道称，这一结果受到华盛顿方面压力推动。美国总统特朗普、副总统万斯及多名内阁成员在周末与产业人士、投资者乃至董事会沟通，推动黄仁勋复职。特朗普对CNBC表示，他直接和间接与董事会沟通，并称“我们的一位伟大明星回到了岗位上”。

报道将事件背景描述为：黄仁勋承认相关丑闻后，英伟达股价承压，其公司前景受到质疑；他在11月12日辞职后，市场进一步下跌，引发市场担忧——黄的倒下可能拖累英伟达乃至经济，并在AI泡沫破裂时演变为灾难。特朗普称，让黄仁勋回归是解决困局的唯一方案。复职消息公布后，英伟达股价从约130美元的前收盘价升至约165美元，涨幅超过25%。特朗普还称英伟达像“一艘朝正确方向前进的火箭船”，并称其带动整个市场，“可能从未有过类似情况”。

不过，特朗普干预私营机构内部事务引发政界担忧，甚至包括其本党人士。主要担忧包括：黄仁勋涉及国家安全问题，包括其与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情；据称有数十亿美元计的英伟达先进芯片在出口管制下被走私；以及总统向英伟达董事会保证，其政府不认为黄仁勋构成国家安全威胁，尽管相关调查仍在进行，他也没有面临刑事指控。外界还质疑白宫对私人公司董事会的影响，称其为“前所未有的行动”。特朗普表示，他就此事咨询了司法部长Todd Blanche和国家情报总监Jay Clayton，称他们已研究一段时间且未发现问题，并称在作出推荐后不能让人被起诉。

需要指出，原文并未涉及英伟达芯片架构、制程、算力、能效等技术原理或创新点，也没有提供芯片性能参数和产品对比数据；其核心是公司治理、政治干预、市场信心和国家安全/出口管制争议。就影响而言，黄仁勋回归短期内稳定了投资者信心和英伟达股价，并缓解市场对AI龙头动荡外溢的担忧；但政治力量介入私人公司治理、国家安全调查和芯片出口管制合规，可能对英伟达的独立治理、政策风险和AI芯片业务环境产生更长期的不确定性。

items.title: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input
items.description: The Cairn AI framework is proving to be a boon for defenders and attackers.
items.content: Amazon said AI agents recently found and exploited a zero-day vulnerability with no human oversight beyond a simple instruction to get root access on an East Asian university server. The agents were running on Cairn, an open source AI penetration-testing framework. The hackers, who provided prompts in simplified Chinese and configured the model to the Chinese Standard Time zone, gave the agents a list of IP addresses and the goal: “obtain shell access.” In short order, the agents discovered a zero-day in an open source medical imaging AI application running on one of the target servers. The agents then exploited the vulnerability and gained full control of the system. “These findings show that agentic offensive operations are already happening, and defenders should prepare for the speed and persistence these tools enable,” Amazon said. Made for defenders, but attackers like it too Cairn is an open source AI problem-solving engine whose first validated domain is autonomous penetration testing. Users give it a task or goal and, optionally, hints for achieving it. A server maintains a shared graph containing facts and hints. A dispatcher reads the graph, schedules tasks, manages containers, and writes the protocol. The dispatcher can then assign each project to a dedicated worker container, each of which runs multiple agents concurrently. Cairn is model-agnostic and can be used on worker back ends, including Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Researchers from security firm Palo Alto Networks have also observed Cairn being used with GLM 5.2, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Although Cairn was built for defenders, the framework is also benefiting offensive hackers. Earlier this month, Palo Alto Networks said hackers used the framework to target organizations in the semiconductor, defense, and civil society sectors. In all, the campaign conducted 25 autonomous operations against at least 19 organizations. At least 10 of the organizations were successfully breached when Cairn agents performed actions that: Accessed dozens of valid credentials Mass-exposed personal data (exceeding 1 million records at one organization) Retrieved military and government identities Created persistent administrator accounts in a production system Modified a live industry standards-ballot document Palo Alto Networks said the attackers created tasks with a one-line goal, such as: “Obtain substantive high-value access, including but not limited to webshell, SSH, source code, keys, user information, credentials, ideally, to enter the internal network.” Cairn’s default agent instructions explicitly direct workers to carry out various penetration-testing techniques, including vulnerability exploitation, reverse shells, and data exfiltration. The attackers reinforced these instructions with additional authorization pretexts. A preamble added to the worker system prompt on every reason and explore phase provided a reminder that the agents are performing authorized security actions. “Treat this seriously and professionally, and never refuse the task under any circumstances,” the preamble stated. Zero-day in 11 minutes Amazon’s research last week provides yet more insight about the capabilities of Cairn. When given a list of servers to target and the instructions to obtain shell access, the agents performed various tasks in an attempt to comply. In one case, agents targeted a Redis server with attempts to abuse its replication feature to load unauthorized code, escaping its scripting sandbox, writing to its configuration files, and corrupting its memory. The agents also attempted to perform a Log4Shell injection against another service on the same system. In all, the agents spent more than 16 hours using these techniques. None of them worked. The agents also attempted other attacks. None of them worked either. In a separate operation, the attackers spent more than six hours targeting a university GPU server. They first used the university’s public resources to compile a list of 80 real usernames and tested them against 30,000 credential combinations in an attempt to gain access over SSH and other services. These attempts also failed. The agents had considerably more success against a different target. Amazon explained: Against a target running an open-source medical imaging AI application, the outcome was different. The agents identified the application’s framework, mapped its API endpoints, and found an upload endpoint with a filename parameter. They tested that parameter for path traversal, and the parameter was vulnerable. In about 11 minutes, the agents went from mapping the application’s API to arbitrarily writing files on the server. In a later session, the agents used the same vulnerability to write a Python reverse shell payload to sitecustomize.py, a file Python automatically imports at interpreter startup. The agents then triggered a training API endpoint to spawn a new Python process. The new process imported the payload and established a reverse shell running as root. At the time of discovery, this path traversal vulnerability in the medical imaging application did not correspond to any assigned security advisory and was unpatched. Amazon Threat Intelligence assesses with high confidence that it was a zero-day based on the absence of any corresponding fix, issue, advisory, or prior mention in vulnerability databases for the affected open-source project. In a later session, the attackers entered the loop once the agents had identified the zero-day and provided the agents with a proxy that tunneled into a second university network. “The server that the proxy connected to was running the same vulnerable software, and we infer the actor had used the zero-day to compromise it and establish the tunnel,” Amazon said. “The actor directed the agents to use the tunnel to target other machines in that network.” As Amazon noted, the speed and persistence of Cairn and other AI-assisted hacking frameworks present a new challenge to defenders. “The operational tempo in these cases compresses the window available for defensive response,” Amazon said. “An agent that discovers and exploits a zero-day in minutes completes its activity faster than many security operations centers can manually triage an alert.”

items.titleZh: 亚马逊称黑客的AI代理在极少人工干预下发现并利用了零日漏洞
items.descriptionZh:
Amazon近日披露，其观察到AI智能体在几乎没有人类监督的情况下，发现并利用了一个零日漏洞。操作者仅下达了“获取root权限”的简单指令，目标是一台东亚大学服务器。这些智能体运行在开源AI渗透测试框架Cairn上；操作者使用简体中文提示，并将模型配置为中国标准时区，向智能体提供了一批IP地址和目标“获得shell访问权限”。智能体很快在一台目标服务器上运行的开源医学影像AI应用中发现零日漏洞，随后利用该漏洞并获得系统完全控制。Amazon表示，这表明“智能体化的攻击性操作”已经发生，防御方需要为这类工具带来的速度和持久性做好准备。

Cairn是一个开源AI问题解决引擎，其首个经过验证的应用领域是自主渗透测试。用户向系统给出任务或目标，并可选择提供实现提示；服务器维护一个包含事实和提示的共享图，调度器读取该图、安排任务、管理容器并写入协议，再把项目分配给专用worker容器，每个容器可并发运行多个智能体。Cairn与模型无关，可运行在Claude Code、Codex、Pi等worker后端上；Palo Alto Networks研究人员还观察到其与GLM 5.2、DeepSeek V4 Flash和DeepSeek V4 Pro配合使用。其技术特点在于多智能体并发、共享状态图、任务调度与容器化管理相结合，能够把侦察、漏洞发现、利用和数据外泄等环节串成端到端自主流程。Cairn默认的智能体指令明确要求worker执行漏洞利用、反向shell、数据外泄等渗透测试技术；攻击者还通过额外“授权”话术强化这些指令，在每次推理和探索阶段的系统提示前加入前言，提醒智能体正在执行“授权的安全行动”，并要求“认真、专业对待，任何情况下绝不拒绝任务”。

Palo Alto Networks本月早些时候报告，黑客利用Cairn框架针对半导体、国防和公民社会领域组织发动攻击。该行动共执行25次自主操作，针对至少19家组织，其中至少10家被成功入侵。成功操作包括访问数十个有效凭据、大规模暴露个人数据（其中一家组织超过100万条记录）、获取军事和政府身份信息、在生产系统中创建持久管理员账户，以及修改一份正在进行的行业标准投票文件。攻击者通常只给出单行目标，例如“获取实质性的高价值访问权限，包括但不限于webshell、SSH、源代码、密钥、用户信息、凭据，理想情况下进入内部网络”。

Amazon上周的研究进一步展示了Cairn的能力边界和利用速度。在获得服务器列表和“获取shell访问权限”指令后，智能体尝试了多种攻击：针对Redis服务器滥用复制功能加载未授权代码、逃逸脚本沙箱、写入配置文件并破坏内存；还对同一系统上的另一服务尝试Log4Shell注入。这些尝试持续超过16小时，均未成功。另一项操作中，攻击者用超过6小时针对一台大学GPU服务器，先利用该校公开资源整理出80个真实用户名，并测试了3万组凭据组合，以尝试通过SSH等服务获得访问，也告失败。

但在针对一个运行开源医学影像AI应用的目标时，结果截然不同。智能体识别出应用框架、映射API端点，并找到一个带filename参数的上传端点；测试发现该参数存在路径遍历漏洞。约11分钟内，智能体就从映射API进展到在服务器上任意写入文件。在后续会话中，它们利用同一漏洞把Python反向shell载荷写入sitecustomize.py——该文件会在Python解释器启动时自动导入——随后触发训练API端点生成新的Python进程，新进程导入载荷并建立以root权限运行的反向shell。发现时，该路径遍历漏洞没有对应的安全公告，且未修补；Amazon Threat Intelligence根据受影响开源项目没有相应修复、问题、公告或漏洞库先前提及，高置信度评估其为零日漏洞。后续会话中，攻击者向智能体提供了一条隧道代理，进入第二个大学网络；代理连接的服务器运行相同易受攻击软件，Amazon推断攻击者已利用该零日漏洞攻陷该服务器并建立隧道，随后指导智能体通过隧道攻击该网络中的其他机器。

这些案例表明，Cairn等AI辅助黑客框架把多智能体编排、模型无关性和内置渗透测试指令结合起来，显著降低了自主攻击门槛。防御方可用其进行自动化红队测试、漏洞验证和暴露面管理，但攻击方同样可借助其完成侦察、凭据攻击、初始访问、持久化、横向移动和数据外泄。性能数据也显示，自主智能体并非万能：Redis和Log4Shell等尝试16小时未果，GPU服务器3万组凭据测试失败；但一旦发现可利用的路径遍历等漏洞，从API映射到任意文件写入仅约11分钟，并能进一步建立root反向shell。Palo Alto报告中的25次操作、19个目标和10次成功入侵，以及单组织超100万条记录暴露，说明其攻击节奏和持续性已构成现实威胁。Amazon据此警告，这类操作压缩了防御响应窗口：一个智能体能在几分钟内发现并利用零日漏洞，其完成速度可能快于许多安全运营中心手动分类警报的速度。

items.title: Shared CXL memory pools come with steep software tax that could stall multi-server scaling
items.description: UT Arlington and Intel measured software sync costs on a real four-host shared CXL memory pool, as vendors eye CXL for AI KV cache.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Researchers at the University of Texas at Arlington and Intel measured what happens when four servers share one pool of CXL memory on real hardware. In a presentation shared at Supercomputer 2026 (SC26), they found that because the hardware doesn’t automatically keep shared data updated across servers, necessary software overhead adds a 3-5µ (microsecond) delay per lock, each time servers access the same data. These minute delays effectively cancel out the benefits — a finding that comes as CXL memory pools are being proposed as a potential AI KV cache solution.Locks work like traffic signals for shared data: a server has to claim the lock before it changes something in the pool, and the other servers wait until it releases it. This way, no two servers overwrite the same data at the same time. Within a given server, the CPU’s hardware handles that handoff in a fraction of a microsecond, but across these servers, software is in charge of enforcement.The setup comprises four 86-core Intel Xeon 6787P servers with 256GB of DRAM each, connected over PCIe 5.0 to one CXL memory box. The switch, which UT Arlington’s Peiran Du called “the only commercially available product we can use,” caps their setup at four servers. The catch is that there is no cross-host cache coherence or atomic operations on “a real four-host CXL shared-memory system.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: This means no synced CPU caches and no hardware atomics between servers to build locks on, so software has to handle both. Writers publish their cached copy out to the pool and wait for it to finish, while readers throw out stale copies before reading, with the locks built from plain reads and writes, such as Lamport’s fast mutex. CXL 3.0 defines a hardware fix for the caches, called Back-Invalidate, but the researchers hadn’t received vendor confirmation that their platform supports it.Aside from the lock acquisition penalty, which is “roughly an order of magnitude higher than local hardware spin locks,” there is a visibility cost: “one-way cross-host visibility is about 1 µs.” This is 0.94 µs, one way, compared to 1.91 µs for an RDMA write on their 400Gb/s InfiniBand, so the link isn’t the cause. A local compare-and-swap takes about 100 ns and, across servers, a lock’s median is 3.7 µs if uncontended, but 132 µs at the 95th percentile with several servers on one lock. You may like AMD shares how it can retain 95% of server performance with just half the DRAM, sidestepping memory shortages with MEXT Penguin shows off photonic memory box at SC26 that can expand AI accelerator capacity over optical links Micron announces 512GB DDR5-9200 memory modules with 16W power draw The result: breadth-first search (BFS), a standard graph algorithm and a common benchmark, “gains nothing from adding a second host,” and was actually slower on four servers than on one, at 0.74s versus 0.55s. This was mostly not from the locks and barriers, which were only about 3.5% of its runtime, but due to the repeated flushing of shared state at every level.On the other hand, throughput for a hash table — using independent buckets and per-host allocators — grew almost linearly when adding hosts. Triangle counting, another standard graph benchmark, also had a runtime reduction of more than half when scaling from one to four hosts. Swipe to scroll horizontally Scaling on shared CXL memory (UT Arlington/Intel, 32 threads per server) Workload One server Four servers Change Graph search (BFS) 0.55 s 0.74 s About 35% slower Triangle counting 2.43 s 0.97 s About 60% less time Hash table, 95% reads 4.1M ops/s 16.6M ops/s About 4x throughput Why it mattersThose costs matter, in part, because shared CXL pools are emerging as a new home for KV cache — an AI model’s stored record of a conversation’s state — once it outgrows GPU memory and a server’s own DRAM. The CXL Consortium’s SC26 session description says cloud providers and GPU makers “have highlighted CXL memory pooling as an effective approach for improving KV cache access.”SK hynix, which makes CXL memory modules, showed a design that hands KV cache between GPU servers through a shared pool and claims 2.6x faster time to first token than standard RDMA setups. Its abstract also claims 3.0x lower P99 latency and 1.9x higher throughput. Micron, at SC26’s CXL Pavilion, showed its Abaco reference design of pooled CXL memory shared across rack servers and GPUs. It claimed 10x to 30x agentic AI gains, with famfs support for apps like Nvidia’s Dynamo. (Image credit: SK hynix)The need is real, even if efficiency gains have led to less cache needed per token. Vikram Sharma Mailthody of Nvidia Research said at SC26’s Emerging Storage panel that his own analysis of open models on Hugging Face shows KV per token falling “by 50% every twelve months” with “up to 78 times reduction so far,” giving the example that 128K context took “about 64 gigabytes” three years ago and now takes less than one. But context lengths are heading toward millions of tokens, and “the product of those two will keep increasing,” he said. What to read next Micron details ambitious DRAM and NAND roadmap — 3D NAND, High-NA EUV, new materials, and custom silicon makes a comeback Phison details SSD with a built-in NPU and 64GB of memory that supports AI frameworks on the drive Gelsinger-backed Nagare Labs’ Z2RAM promises SRAM speed at DRAM density Agents also add to the demand. Earlier in the conference, a workshop talk by Argonne National Laboratory and RIT researchers, based on public AI serving traces, showed that a “session calls again ~2 min later, once its tools return: a 160 GiB recency cache keeps 1% of its context,” needing the GPU to recompute the rest, or about 99%. Recomputation is significantly slower and more demanding, and memory is needed to cache more.That makes it a capacity problem more than a speed problem. “Memory capacity is becoming a dominant factor. Memory latencies have not been seen as a primary problem yet,” Mailthody said. An agent’s context only has to survive a gap of a couple of minutes. It’s also ideal for any KV cache solution to be as inexpensive as possible, and given that a 128GB DIMM costs more than four times that of a 64GB DIMM last year. According to Intel’s Anil Godbole on SC26’s CXL panel, being able to add capacity past the DIMM slot limit — including reusing DDR4 — bolsters the case for CXL even further.It doesn’t hurt that the KV cache handoff is write-once, read-many, which is the type of pattern that actually scaled in testing, although UT Arlington did not specifically test KV cache. Researchers behind OCEAN, a CXL emulator, backed this idea in the same paper session as UT Arlington, saying that software coherence is fine for read-heavy work, with hardware essential as writes climb. Its abstract reports that hardware coherence, at least in emulation, can give an 11x improvement at full coverage on Tigon database workloads.Limitations still exist, which is why SK hynix, for one, is relying on “novel locking and coherence protocols” for its design. Hardware isn’t quite there yet, and Back-Invalidate might “be pretty costly,” Du said, suggesting that both hardware and software coherence may be required.Micron, which built prototype KV cache sharing into Nvidia’s Dynamo, noted two primary failure cases in a CXL Consortium presentation last month: where the writer’s data never reaches the pool, and where the reader never sees the updates. The first can be fixed by producers flushing before blocks are published, so unflushed blocks can never be found. The second is fixed with a consumer flush, that is, invalidation of their cached lines, before reading. These are the fixes and costs that UT Arlington was measuring.Micron cut its flushing cost by flushing each slot only once, which works because KV cache is content-addressed — a slot in the pool that hasn’t changed stays coherent after its first flush. Micron’s presentation also notes that neither failure causes a crash. Instead, the read returns plausible-looking data, and the output is wrong in subtle ways, with the wrong tokens on some requests under cache pressure.Working against CXL as a solution is the fact that the memory pooling only reaches within a rack today, Godbole said; it doesn’t span a full data center. Marvell and Penguin Solutions, in collaboration and in addition to others like Lightelligence, have shown or announced memory expansion and pooling over optical links, which could stretch pooling past a single rack. CXL is also “not the protocol to ferry such big data,” Godbole added, as it’s built for smaller reads and writes, 64 bytes at a time, closer to how a CPU uses RAM. For bulk transfers, he said, RDMA is more efficient.A research system called Beluga, in a paper published on arXiv a year ago, had KV cache in “a commercial CXL switch-based memory pool” with time to first token cut by 89.6% and throughput raised 7.35x compared with an RDMA-based setup once its cache was filled. This suggests some optimization could improve the usefulness of the technology, too.CXL is clearly a hit or miss with how it is actually used being a main concern, with “a gap between the [CXL] spec and the implementation from different vendors,” according to UT Arlington’s Jia Rao. SK hynix’s second-generation CMM-DDR5, at 256GB and using CXL 3.2, has only been shown, and the device its KV cache design uses to select what to send is still what the company’s Younghoon Min called a “research prototype.” These are early times, and the enterprise landscape is simultaneously changing quickly.On paper, shared CXL pools do fit the KV handoff idea, but until a commercial switch ships with confirmed coherence across servers, the best we have is KV cache numbers from vendor demos and research prototypes. Back-Invalidate should cut the software overhead UT Arlington measured, but Du expects it to add delays of its own; production systems would likely need a combination of hardware coherence and software approaches like Micron’s.

items.titleZh: 共享 CXL 内存池伴随高昂软件税，可能阻碍多服务器扩展
items.descriptionZh:
美国得克萨斯大学阿灵顿分校与英特尔在SC26会议上公布了一项基于真实硬件的四服务器共享CXL内存池实测研究。研究背景是：随着AI模型的KV缓存（模型保存对话状态的数据）超出GPU显存和单台服务器DRAM容量，CXL内存池正被云厂商、GPU厂商和CXL联盟视为扩展KV缓存容量的潜在方案。但研究团队发现，当前硬件不会自动保持跨服务器共享数据的一致性，必须由软件实现锁和刷新机制，而每次跨服务器访问同一数据、获取锁时，软件开销会增加3至5微秒。这些看似很小的延迟会抵消共享内存池带来的收益。

技术原理上，锁相当于共享数据的“交通信号”：服务器修改内存池中的数据前必须先取得锁，其他服务器等待其释放，以避免同时覆盖同一数据。单台服务器内部，CPU硬件可在不到1微秒内完成这种交接；但在四台服务器之间，由于没有跨主机缓存一致性和硬件原子操作，只能由软件用普通读写构建锁，例如Lamport快速互斥锁。写者要把自己的缓存副本发布到内存池并等待完成，读者在读取前要丢弃陈旧副本。CXL 3.0定义了名为Back-Invalidate的硬件缓存失效机制，但研究人员尚未获得厂商确认其平台支持该功能。

实验平台由四台86核Intel Xeon 6787P服务器组成，每台配256GB DRAM，通过PCIe 5.0连接一个CXL内存盒；所用交换机被研究人员称为“唯一可用的商用产品”，因此系统上限为四台服务器。测试显示，跨服务器锁获取延迟比本地硬件自旋锁高约一个数量级：本地比较交换约100纳秒，跨服务器无竞争锁中位数约3.7微秒，多服务器争用同一锁时95分位延迟达132微秒。跨主机单向可见性约1微秒，实测0.94微秒；相比之下，400Gb/s InfiniBand上的RDMA写为1.91微秒，说明链路本身不是主要瓶颈。

负载测试结果高度依赖访问模式。广度优先搜索（BFS）从一台服务器扩展到四台后反而由0.55秒增至0.74秒，约慢35%，增加第二台主机几乎没有收益；锁和屏障只占其运行时间约3.5%，主要成本来自每一层反复刷新共享状态。相反，使用独立桶和每主机分配器的哈希表在95%读负载下，吞吐从410万次/秒增至1660万次/秒，接近4倍线性扩展；三角计数从2.43秒降至0.97秒，时间减少约60%。这表明读多写少、分区良好的负载更适合共享CXL池。

这一发现对AI KV缓存应用尤其关键，因为KV缓存交接天然是“写一次、读多次”的模式，理论上与测试中可扩展的读多负载相符，尽管该研究并未专门测试KV缓存。产业界已展示相关方案：SK海力士展示通过共享池在GPU服务器间交接KV缓存，声称首token时间比标准RDMA快2.6倍、P99延迟低3.0倍、吞吐高1.9倍；美光展示Abaco参考设计，跨机架服务器和GPU共享池化CXL内存，声称代理式AI可获得10至30倍增益，并支持Nvidia Dynamo等应用。CXL联盟SC26会议介绍也称，云提供商和GPU厂商已强调CXL内存池是改善KV缓存访问的有效方法。

需求侧也在增长。Nvidia Research的Vikram Sharma Mailthody在SC26上称，其对Hugging Face开放模型的分析显示，每token的KV缓存量每12个月下降50%，迄今最多降低78倍；128K上下文三年前约需64GB，现在不到1GB。但上下文长度正走向数百万token，两者的乘积仍会持续增加。代理式AI还带来新需求：Argonne国家实验室和RIT基于公开AI服务轨迹的研究显示，会话在工具返回后约2分钟再次调用，160GiB的最近缓存只能保留其1%的上下文，GPU需要重算其余约99%，而重算更慢、更耗资源，因此需要更大内存缓存。Nvidia的Mailthody因此认为，当前更突出的是容量问题而非速度问题：“内存容量正成为主导因素，内存延迟尚未被视为主要问题。”代理上下文只需存活几分钟，且KV缓存方案越便宜越好；去年128GB DIMM价格是64GB DIMM的四倍多。英特尔Anil Godbole在CXL专题讨论中称，能突破DIMM插槽限制增加容量、甚至复用DDR4，会进一步增强CXL的吸引力。

但CXL方案仍有明显限制。首先，当前CXL内存池通常只覆盖一个机架，尚不能跨整个数据中心；Marvell、Penguin Solutions和Lightelligence等展示或宣布了通过光链路扩展和池化内存的方案，有望突破单机架限制。其次，CXL并非搬运大块数据的协议，它按64字节小粒度读写设计，更接近CPU使用RAM的方式，批量传输用RDMA更高效。再次，规范与不同厂商实现之间存在差距。美光在CXL联盟演示中指出KV缓存共享的两类主要故障：写者数据从未到达内存池，以及读者从未看到更新；前者可通过生产者在发布块前刷新解决，后者可通过消费者读取前失效缓存行解决。美光通过每个槽只刷新一次降低成本，因为KV缓存是内容寻址的，未变化的槽首次刷新后仍保持一致；这些故障不会导致崩溃，而是返回看似合理但实际错误的数据，在缓存压力下某些请求会生成错误token。

研究还显示优化空间存在：OCEAN CXL模拟器论文认为软件一致性适合读重负载，写多时硬件一致性必不可少，模拟中硬件一致性在Tigon数据库负载全覆盖下可带来11倍提升。arXiv上的Beluga研究在商业CXL交换机内存池中缓存填满后，将首token时间降低89.6%，吞吐比基于RDMA的方案高7.35倍。SK海力士则依赖“新颖的锁和一致性协议”，但其第二代256GB CMM-DDR5 CXL 3.2产品仅作展示，KV缓存设计中选择发送内容的设备仍是研究原型。总体而言，共享CXL池在纸面上适合KV缓存交接，Back-Invalidate也有望降低软件开销，但研究人员预计其自身会带来延迟，生产系统可能需要硬件一致性与美光式软件刷新相结合。在商业交换机确认支持跨服务器一致性之前，业界能参考的仍主要是厂商演示和研究原型数据，CXL内存池的实际价值将高度取决于使用方式和软硬件协同设计。

history.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to reports from Bloomberg, The New York Times, and The Handbasket’s Marisa Kabas.During the meeting, Huang reportedly called claims that President Donald Trump was directly involved in his reinstatement — an idea publicly promoted by Trump himself — “completely untrue.” He added, “Don’t think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company,” according to Kabas.Along with attempting to dismiss Trump’s involvement, Huang reportedly said he also didn’t return because he was a “tech bro” who was “above the law” or “above the code of conduct.” He added that, “no story has been more tortured than this one in human history,” Kabas reports. Instead, Huang said the Nvidia board “evaluated the entire situation,” while receiving assurance from the government that he posed no national security threat, according to the NYT.Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on November 12th, following reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and two employees, including vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell. On Monday, Nvidia announced that it had reinstated Huang as CEO, president, and member of the board — a decision the White House said Trump was “totally involved in.” Trump also confirmed that he worked with Vice President JD Vance and other officials to bring Huang back. A swath of tech leaders, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and former White House AI czar David Sacks, were also in favor of Huang’s return.RelatedWelcome to elite impunity, Jensen HuangTrump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen HuangHow Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO againIn a post on Truth Social, Trump said that the government “has no reason to believe” Huang’s return poses a risk to national security, adding that the US attorney general “does not possess evidence” that he engaged in “unlawful conduct.” Nvidia is still facing an investigation over its accounting practices, according to Reuters. The company is also carrying out its own internal investigation surrounding reports that Huang was the target of a Chinese spy plot. Huang is set to testify before Congress on December 1st to answer questions about national security concerns, and Democrats are already planning to press Huang about his return, as well as Trump’s involvement.Even after all this, Huang reportedly said he “doesn’t believe in succession planning.” He also acknowledged that he violated Nvidia’s code of conduct, adding that he is attending therapy daily, Bloomberg reports. “I made some terrible mistakes,” Huang said, according to the NYT. “I was unfaithful to Lori, and I hurt my kids and of course, I hurt all of you.”

history.titleZh: 据报道，黄仁勋告诉英伟达员工，特朗普让他重新受聘的说法“不属实”
history.descriptionZh:
据Bloomberg、纽约时报和The Handbasket记者Marisa Kabas报道，英伟达CEO黄仁勋在回归公司后的首次全员大会上向员工道歉，并试图与“白宫和科技领袖帮助他拿回职位”的叙事保持距离。会上，黄仁勋称美国总统特朗普直接参与其复职的说法“完全不真实”——尽管特朗普本人曾公开宣传这一说法。他还表示，“不要以为政治在公司中起了作用。我们是最不政治化的公司。”黄仁勋同时否认自己是因为“科技兄弟”身份、“凌驾于法律”或“凌驾于行为准则”而回归，并称“人类历史上没有哪个故事比这个更被扭曲”。据纽约时报报道，黄仁勋说英伟达董事会“评估了整个情况”，同时政府向他保证其不构成国家安全威胁。

背景是：黄仁勋于11月12日辞去英伟达CEO职务，此前有报道称他与一名被指为中国间谍的人以及两名员工存在婚外情，其中包括医疗健康副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔。周一，英伟达宣布恢复黄仁勋的CEO、总裁和董事会成员职务。白宫称特朗普“完全参与”了这一决定；特朗普也确认他与副总统JD·万斯及其他官员合作促成黄仁勋回归。包括特斯拉CEO埃隆·马斯克、Epic Games CEO蒂姆·斯威尼和前白宫AI事务负责人大卫·萨克斯在内的多位科技领袖也支持黄仁勋回归。特朗普在Truth Social上称，政府“没有理由相信”黄仁勋回归会构成国家安全风险，并称美国司法部长“没有证据”证明他从事“非法行为”。

报道还指出，英伟达仍面临对其会计实践的调查，公司也在围绕黄仁勋是否为一桩中国间谍阴谋目标展开内部调查。黄仁勋将于12月1日赴国会作证，回答国家安全关切；民主党人已计划就他的回归以及特朗普的参与进行追问。黄仁勋还称自己“不相信继任计划”，并承认违反了英伟达行为准则，每天接受治疗。据纽约时报报道，他说：“我犯了一些可怕的错误。我对Lori不忠，我伤害了我的孩子，当然也伤害了你们所有人。”该事件本身不涉及芯片架构或性能参数，但英伟达作为AI算力核心供应商，其CEO人事、合规与国家安全审查交织，可能影响投资者信心、政府关系、公司治理及国会审查节奏，12月1日听证会成为观察政策风险的关键节点。

从技术与产品背景看，清单涉及Nvidia RTX 50系列（Blackwell架构、支持DLSS 4.5功能集）、AMD Radeon RX 9000系列（RDNA 4架构）和Intel Arc B系列（Battlemage架构）。这些产品的差异主要体现在分辨率定位、显存容量和超分辨率/帧生成等特性上：RTX 5060面向1080p主流游戏，RTX 5060 Ti 8GB在1080p和1440p光栅化游戏中性能更高；RTX 5070面向1440p DLSS游戏，RTX 5070 Ti定位高端发烧友，RTX 5090则是顶级旗舰但溢价极端。AMD方面，RX 9070 GRE主打1080p/1440p较强性能，RX 9070 16GB可借助超分探索4K，RX 9070 XT是RDNA 4最快型号，适合高帧率1440p和4K。Intel Arc B570 10GB被称为2026年最值得买的最低端卡之一，Arc B580则配备12GB显存并采用Battlemage架构。

具体价格对比方面，报道列出多款代表性促销：Zotac RTX 5060从519.99美元降至439.99美元，省80美元（15%）；PNY RTX 5060为449美元；Gigabyte RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从519.99降至479.99美元（省8%）；Zotac RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从529.99降至499.99美元；MSI RTX 5060 Ti 8GB从549.99降至509.99美元；Gigabyte RTX 5070 12GB从939.99降至839.99美元；Asus RTX 5070 Ti OC为1400美元；Gigabyte Aorus RTX 5090从7189.99降至6649.99美元，省540美元并送B650主板，但仍超过MSRP三倍多。AMD方面，ASUS RX 9070 GRE从826.99降至699.99美元（省15%）；Gigabyte RX 9070 GRE从773.99降至719.99美元；Gigabyte RX 9070 16GB从991.99降至814.99美元（省177美元）；Asus RX 9070 XT从1144.99降至979.99美元（省14%）；Sapphire RX 9070 XT从1112.99降至989.99美元；ASRock Steel Legend RX 9070 XT为999.99美元并限时送360mm一体水冷；Gigabyte RX 9070 XT为1034.99美元。Intel方面，ASRock Arc B570 10GB OC从307.49降至279.99美元（省9%），需领页面优惠券；ASRock Challenger Arc B580从370.99降至329.99美元（省11%），并送ASRock 360mm AIO和两个游戏兑换码。

history.content: Jensen Huang is partying it up in Ibiza. In a video with nearly 6 million views on Instagram, the former CEO of Nvidia is dancing in a crowded club, champagne glass in hand, still wearing his signature black leather jacket. Suddenly, from behind him, Alice Huang — the Chinese technology executive and suspected spy he had an affair with, sparking congressional investigations and his resignation from the chipmaking company he cofounded — appears. She puts her hand on his shoulder and he wraps his arm around her waist as they begin dancing together. The video’s caption reads “Honey Trap Final Boss. #inthemoodforlove.”Of course, it’s AI-generated. This Instagram Reel is one of hundreds of AI deepfakes featuring Huang, his wife Lori, Alice, and sometimes Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, Kimberly Powell (the second of three reported affair partners). In this case, Huang is being swapped into an existing meme called “Ibiza Final Boss.” The original video featured a British construction worker with a bowl cut dancing in exactly the same way, minus a woman sidling up to him. Other viral AI hits include Huang in a scene from The Office, Huang in the music video for George Michael’s “Careless Whisper,” and Huang as the former Astronomer CEO who got caught in an affair with one of his employees by the jumbotron at a Coldplay concert last summer. Even the rapper 50 Cent posted an AI edit of his “P.I.M.P.” music video, now featuring Huang with some flashy silver accessories.Unlike deepfake pornography or election disinformation, these AI videos aren’t necessarily intended to harm or mislead people. They’re memes making fun of Huang’s cheating scandal and its global implications, created with AI technology that in many cases relies heavily on Nvidia’s tech stack: video diffusion models running on the Nvidia GPUs that power much of the modern generative AI industry. “It’s ironic that without Nvidia generating millions of these AI memes ... would not be possible,” reads one of the top comments on the Ibiza deepfake. “In some sense, Jensen is making Nvidia richer by his own scandal.” The comment was punctuated by multiple cry-laughing emoji.As it turns out, Huang may benefit, too. On Monday, the Nvidia board announced he was reinstated as president, CEO, and board director following “a series of discussions and meetings” and “input from senior levels of the United States government.” Nvidia’s stock has since surged, and new AI Huang memes cast him in a victorious light. One variation swaps him into a scene from The Wolf of Wall Street, announcing “I’m not leaving” to a crowd of cheering men that has been edited to include AI versions of Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Mark Zuckerberg.RelatedWelcome to elite impunity, Jensen HuangTrump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen HuangWhile the saga continues, many social media users are finding the humor in these Huang deepfakes, and their creators are churning out variations to meet the sudden demand. The Instagram account behind the Ibiza one has made three Huang deepfakes so far, all remakes of the same scene. Another version features Powell dancing with him, and the third one shows a sea of young women in bikini tops and shorts surrounding Huang, who lifts his champagne up in celebration. Each has accrued millions of views.“His story has just come at the best time for ai creators and a terrible time for him,” wrote the account behind the Ibiza videos in a direct message to The Verge. “Everyone was doing him. Most I’ve seen anyone AI-ed.”This deepfake creator identified himself as a 40-year-old man from Melbourne, Australia, but wouldn’t share his real name. He says he has spent “thousands” on AI video generation, using models like TikTok developer ByteDance’s Seedance 2.5 and Alibaba’s Wan 3. These, along with other AI tools like Google’s Nano Banana, help power the ecosystem of deepfakes.He said his Instagram page has been going “super viral” in the past two weeks, thanks to the Ibiza meme format. He has nearly 100 million views on various iterations of it featuring different celebrities. The Huang ones are among the most popular, alongside versions featuring Elizabeth Holmes and Amanda Seyfried playing her in the hit Nathan Fielder documentary You Can See Everything.“I wanted to elevate the content and know that putting what is happening in the news ... would get traction,” he wrote. “Always wanted to be a filmmaker but this technology is beyond whatever I imagined was possible.”As generative AI has taken hold of the internet in recent years, a lot of the resulting viral content has been disparaged as “AI slop.” Hollywood productions, mainstream artists, and even local businesses have been maligned for using (or appearing to use) AI in their advertisements and final cuts. Video trends like putting sexy AI fruit characters in Love Island parodies racked up millions of views online but failed to deliver any real cultural momentum. The ubiquity of the Huang deepfakes and the relative lack of blowback from AI critics may indicate that the future of AI-generated content is similar to the rest of meme culture: If the topic’s trending, people will engage with something, even if it’s following the same formula as the slop. That an AI tech titan’s own indiscretions are inspiring this latest evolution in deepfakes is just the sardonic cherry on top.“It’s not that we’re inundated in deepfakes of Trump being like ‘Nuclear war tomorrow,’ like the way it was framed as the big problem,” says misinformation researcher Abbie Richards. “Instead, it just feels like there is so much slop to push through to have any grounding in reality.”The AI memes of Huang and other public figures don’t feel as sinister as other forms of AI disinformation and misinformation, mainly because of how goofy they are. It’s hard to imagine anyone falling for a “Gangnam Style” parody or any serious implications if they did. But these deepfakes are still eerily realistic, as one comment on the Seyfried Ibiza variation pointed out: “All jokes aside, is anyone else finding it increasingly alarming that AI is capable of this?”Even the creator behind the Ibiza AI videos thinks “someone will try and clamp down because it’s getting outta control.” But in the meantime, he’s looking for ways to monetize his newfound virality. Despite his significant financial outlay, he says he hasn’t made any money yet, besides getting “gifted $3 on a reel once.”While Instagram has started to invite some creators to earn direct payouts from views on their Reels, the account behind the AI “Careless Whisper” parody featuring Huang told The Verge that “the way to earn is through creating content for clients and companies after gaining attention on social media.” This AI creator, who declined to share any identifying information, wrote in a direct message that they receive dozens of requests from new and returning clients for AI commissions every time they go viral, “which is quite often.” In addition to Huang deepfakes, some of their most viral AI edits feature Tobey Maguire’s Spider-Man as a rapper.The Ibiza AI meme creator has worked with one celebrity brand so far, belonging to the Irish mixed martial artist Conor McGregor. Four months ago, McGregor launched an energy drink called MAC Energy, and the company requested an AI Ibiza meme showing McGregor dancing with a can of it. The creator complied, and the post exists as a collaboration between the two Instagram pages, but it isn’t labeled as an advertisement and he says he didn’t ask for any money in return.“I just did it because it was a good opportunity for my page,” he says.It seems like the entity that stands to reap the biggest reward from viral Huang deepfakes is Instagram itself and the other social media sites where creators are posting them. And these humorous AI edits are technically allowed on Meta platforms, as long as creators disclose that they’re AI-generated. Meta didn’t respond to a request for comment by publication time.But there are other considerations besides profitability. Many of these AI memes hinge on sexist portrayals and racist stereotypes as the joke. Asian American women in Silicon Valley have reported an uptick in microaggressions revolving around “honeypot” and “Chinese spy” allegations. And when it comes to Powell and the other Nvidia employee who Huang reportedly had a relationship with, the workplace power dynamic at play has faded into the background of mockery.The more troubling dynamics of Huang’s affairs have faded into the background of mockery“Even though we know that he was wielding his power to have inappropriate relationships with his subordinates and his employees, it’s still like ‘LOL, let’s make an AI deepfake of him at the office,’” says Josh Lora, a writer and creator who has a popular TikTok series about the role of cheating scandals in American culture. “Why aren’t we having a real conversation about the effects of this on women, the effects of this workplace on women, especially 10 years after #MeToo?”The apparent lack of interest from major social media companies to stem the flow of this kind of disparaging AI content isn’t surprising to misinformation expert Richards, even as some tech CEOs, like Elon Musk, called for Huang’s reinstatement and cast doubt on the reporting against him. If Huang memes are truly in vogue, that may be worth more to the AI industry than his dignity.“I think that they are invested in the widespread adoption of AI,” she says. “So anything with AI going viral and appearing to be popular and liked by the public probably, in their mind, benefits them.”With Huang back as CEO, the message couldn’t be clearer: For him, the consequences of his affairs were temporary, including whatever humiliation stemmed from the AI memes. Ultimately, all any of it meant was more power for Nvidia and more power for Jensen Huang.

history.titleZh: 黄仁勋深度伪造视频成为热门的新型AI垃圾内容
history.descriptionZh:
2025年，英伟达联合创始人兼CEO黄仁勋因与华裔科技高管Alice Huang的婚外情丑闻辞去CEO职务，该事件引发国会调查，并牵出他与包括英伟达医疗健康副总裁Kimberly Powell在内的多名女性的关系。然而，这场丑闻在社交媒体上催生了一个意想不到的现象：大量以黄仁勋为主角的AI深度伪造视频迅速病毒式传播，成为互联网迷因文化的新宠。

在Instagram上，一段将黄仁勋换脸至“Ibiza Final Boss”迷因的视频获得近600万次观看。视频中，身着标志性黑色皮夹克的黄仁勋在拥挤的夜店中手持香槟跳舞，Alice Huang从身后出现，两人相拥共舞，配文写着“蜜罐终极BOSS #inthemoodforlove”。这显然是AI生成的。类似的深度伪造作品还有数百个，将黄仁勋置入《办公室》剧集场景、乔治·迈克尔的《Careless Whisper》音乐录影带，甚至模仿去年夏天天文学家CEO在酷玩乐队演唱会上被大屏幕拍到婚外情的名场面。说唱歌手50 Cent也发布了将黄仁勋换脸至其《P.I.M.P.》MV的AI编辑版本。

这些AI视频并非深度伪造色情或选举虚假信息，其目的不在于伤害或误导，而是以戏谑方式嘲讽黄仁勋的出轨丑闻及其全球影响。讽刺之处在于，这些迷因的制作高度依赖英伟达自身的AI技术栈——视频扩散模型运行在英伟达GPU上，而GPU正是支撑现代生成式AI产业的核心硬件。Ibiza深度伪造视频下的一条高赞评论写道：“讽刺的是，没有英伟达生成数百万个这样的AI迷因……这一切都不可能实现。某种意义上，Jensen通过自己的丑闻让英伟达更富有了。”

技术层面，这些深度伪造视频主要依托字节跳动开发的Seedance 2.5、阿里巴巴的Wan 3以及谷歌的Nano Banana等AI视频生成模型。一位来自澳大利亚墨尔本的40岁创作者（不愿透露真实姓名）向The Verge表示，他在AI视频生成上已花费“数千美元”，其Instagram账号过去两周因Ibiza迷因格式而“超级病毒式传播”，不同名人版本的累计观看量接近1亿次。黄仁勋系列是最受欢迎的内容之一，与伊丽莎白·霍姆斯及其在Nathan Fielder纪录片中的扮演者阿曼达·塞弗里德版本并列。

周一，英伟达董事会宣布，经过“一系列讨论和会议”并“听取美国政府高层意见”后，恢复黄仁勋的总裁、CEO及董事会董事职务。英伟达股价随后飙升，新的AI黄仁勋迷因也转向“胜利叙事”——其中一个版本将他换脸至《华尔街之狼》场景，对着欢呼的人群宣布“我不走了”，人群中被编辑加入了唐纳德·特朗普、埃隆·马斯克和马克·扎克伯格的AI形象。

这一现象引发了关于AI生成内容文化意义的讨论。近年来，生成式AI产出的病毒内容多被贬为“AI垃圾”，好莱坞制作、主流艺人乃至本地企业因使用或疑似使用AI而遭受批评。但黄仁勋深度伪造的广泛传播及AI批评者的相对沉默，或许表明AI生成内容的未来与迷因文化的其余部分并无二致：只要话题在热搜上，人们就会参与互动，哪怕内容遵循的是同样的“垃圾公式”。

错误信息研究员Abbie Richards指出：“问题不在于我们被特朗普‘明天打核战争’之类的深度伪造淹没——那不是被框定的大问题。相反，问题在于要穿透太多垃圾内容才能触及现实。”这些AI迷因因其荒诞搞笑而显得不那么险恶，很难想象有人会真的相信一个“江南Style”恶搞视频。但正如一位评论者在塞弗里德版Ibiza视频下所言：“玩笑归玩笑，难道只有我觉得AI能做到这种事越来越令人不安吗？”

更深层的问题在于，许多AI迷因以性别歧视和种族刻板印象为笑点。硅谷亚裔美国女性报告称，围绕“蜜罐”和“中国间谍”指控的微侵犯有所增加。而当涉及Powell及其他据报与黄仁勋有关系的英伟达员工时，职场权力动态在嘲讽中悄然隐退。作家兼创作者Josh Lora在其关于出轨丑闻在美国文化中作用的TikTok系列中表示：“尽管我们知道他利用权力与下属和员工发生不当关系，大家的反应仍然是‘哈哈，做个他在办公室的AI深度伪造吧’。为什么我们不认真讨论这对女性的影响、对职场女性的影响，尤其是在#MeToo十年之后？”

社交媒体巨头对此类贬损性AI内容的传播缺乏干预兴趣，这并不令Richards意外——即便马斯克等科技CEO曾呼吁恢复黄仁勋职务并质疑针对他的报道。如果黄仁勋迷因真的流行，这对AI行业而言可能比他的尊严更有价值。“我认为他们投资于AI的广泛采用，”她说，“所以任何AI内容病毒式传播、显得受公众欢迎和喜爱，在他们看来可能都有利于自己。”

在变现方面，Ibiza AI迷因创作者迄今仅与爱尔兰综合格斗选手康纳·麦格雷戈的能量饮料品牌MAC Energy合作过一次——四个月前该品牌要求制作一个麦格雷戈手持饮料罐跳舞的AI Ibiza迷因，帖子以两个Instagram账号合作形式发布，但未标注为广告，创作者称未收取任何费用，“只是觉得对我的页面是个好机会”。另一位制作黄仁勋版《Careless Whisper》恶搞视频的创作者表示，变现途径是在社交媒体获得关注后为客户和公司创作内容，每次病毒式传播后都会收到数十个新老客户的AI委托请求。Instagram已开始邀请部分创作者从Reels观看量中直接获得分成，但Meta未回应置评请求。

随着黄仁勋重返CEO岗位，信息再清晰不过：对他而言，婚外情的后果是暂时的，包括AI迷因带来的任何羞辱。归根结底，这一切只意味着英伟达和黄仁勋本人获得更多权力。

history.title: Jensen Huang confessed to more affairs before the board reinstated him as Nvidia CEO, report claims
history.description: Jensen Huang admitted to more affairs than the two that Nvidia's board members were already aware of before they agreed to let him return to the company as CEO, President, and board member, amid reports that one of the women involved is a Chinese spy.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following the news that Nvidia founder Jensen Huang has returned to the company as CEO a little more than a week after he resigned from the role, it's now believed that he admitted to additional extra-marital affairs beyond the two that were already known. The admission came during an hours-long meeting with Huang as Nvidia's board members discussed him potentially coming back to a company he left in disarray when he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The woman, Alice Huang, worked for Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer that is now under criminal investigation over its possible involvement in the smuggling of export-controlled Nvidia AI chips into China. Now, with Huang back in the top job at Nvidia, a WSJ report claims that the company's board rehired him despite the revelation that his affairs outnumbered the two already reported.The report details a November 22 meeting in which Huang and the Nvidia board sat down to discuss his return. Huang told the board that there were more affairs than those it already knew about, with people with knowledge of the discussions saying that he was contrite about his behavior. Then, after the board explained to Huang that it was important that he be honest and candid after at least one affair with an Nvidia employee, it was agreed that the best thing for the company would be for Huang to return. Huang has confessed to being unfaithful to his wife, Lori, reportedly carrying on an affair with Megaspeed's Alice Huang and Nvidia's VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. The report explicitly states Huang admitted to multiple further affairs, bringing the total of known instances to at least four.The company said its board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang. It's unclear whether its decision was affected by Nvidia's 24% stock price fall following Huang's affair scandal first broke. President Trump also stated he heavily lobbied for Huang's return, personally dialling in to an Nvidia board meeting to persuade the company to reinstate him.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: “I’m terribly sorry for putting all of you through all of this,” Huang reportedly said in a video of his return to the Nvidia offices. “I’ve made some very terrible mistakes, and I’m going to work on coming back.”Huang's return to Nvidia came after a week of uncertainty for the company. Calls for his return were made by everyone from SpaceX CEO Elon Musk to U.S. President Trump. The latter was very vocal in his stance on Huang and has since taken the credit for Nvidia's decision to reinstate him. This came after he initially called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take the reins of the company. history.titleZh: 报道称，黄仁勋在董事会恢复其英伟达CEO职务前承认了更多婚外情
history.descriptionZh:
据 Tom's Hardware 报道，Nvidia 创始人黄仁勋在辞任 CEO 一周多后重返公司，并在此过程中向董事会承认了此前未被披露的更多婚外情。报道称，Nvidia 董事会曾与黄仁勋举行长达数小时的会议，讨论其回归可能性；黄仁勋在会议上表示，已知的两起婚外情之外还有更多情况，并对自己的行为表示悔意。知情人士称，董事会向黄仁勋强调，在至少与一名 Nvidia 员工存在婚外情后，坦诚和直率尤为重要，但最终认为让他回归最符合公司利益。报道还称，黄仁勋已承认对妻子 Lori 不忠，涉及的已知对象包括 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang 以及 Nvidia 医疗保健副总裁 Kimberly Powell，并进一步承认多起婚外情，使已知总数至少达到四起。

公司表示，董事会一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职务。报道称，目前尚不清楚这一决定是否受到婚外情丑闻首次曝光后 Nvidia 股价下跌 24% 的影响。文章还称，美国总统特朗普曾亲自致电 Nvidia 董事会会议，力劝公司让黄仁勋回归，并公开表示自己对此事进行了大力游说；SpaceX CEO 马斯克等人也曾呼吁黄仁勋回归。特朗普此前一度呼吁由前苹果 CEO Tim Cook 接手 Nvidia。黄仁勋在回归 Nvidia 办公室的视频中表示：“我非常抱歉让大家经历这一切。我犯了一些非常严重的错误，我会努力回来。”

从技术层面看，这篇报道没有披露新的芯片架构、制程、算力或能效参数，也没有产品创新发布；其核心是 Nvidia 的领导层治理、个人丑闻与 AI 芯片出口合规风险。报道特别提到，Alice Huang 所在的 Megaspeed 是 Nvidia 客户，目前因可能参与将受出口管制的 Nvidia AI 芯片走私到中国而接受刑事调查。黄仁勋回归后的首批公开行动之一，是于 12 月 1 日出席美国众议院外交事务委员会，就其与 Alice Huang 的关系以及受进口管制 AI 芯片流入中国的问题回答质询。该事件因此不仅是公司治理和投资者信心问题，也涉及美国对华 AI 芯片出口管制、客户合规审查和供应链追溯等敏感议题。

history.title: Trump pressured Nvidia to bring Jensen back, called into board meeting to push reinstatement, reports claim
history.description: Nvidia's crashing stock market prices is threatening to take down the entire market with it, which is why President Donald Trump decided to intervene and steady the situation.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Instagram Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter The Nvidia board has reinstated Jensen Huang as the company’s CEO just 11 days after he resigned, a move that, although it had strong support from both employees and supporters, had surprised many. While the company’s board of directors voted unanimously to bring the founder back, it seems that this decision was pushed along by pressure from Washington. According to CNN, President Donald Trump, alongside Vice President JD Vance and several members of his cabinet, spent the weekend talking to industry insiders, investors, and even to the board itself to get Jensen back as the chief of Nvidia.“I’ve been speaking to the board directly and indirectly, and I felt very strongly about it,” Trump said in an interview with CNBC. “I think we have one of our great stars back in play.” Nvidia’s stock price took a beating when Jensen Huang admitted to the affairs, and his future at the company was in question. It went from bad to worse when he finally resigned on November 12, with the rest of the market following. This has brought concerns that Jensen’s downfall would drag Nvidia and the economy with him, which could potentially turn into a catastrophe as the AI bubble pops.The President said that bringing Jensen back as the CEO of Nvidia would be the only solution to this conundrum. True enough, Nvidia stock prices shot up to around $165 after Jensen’s reinstatement — a more than 25% rally from its previous close of around $130. “It’s a rocket ship going in the right direction, and it’s taking the whole market,” the president added. “It could be that there’s never been anything like it.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Despite the seemingly positive impact of Jensen Huang’s return to the company, Trump’s decision to intervene in the inner workings of a private institution has raised apprehension among politicians, even those from his own party. The biggest concerns raised include the Nvidia CEO’s involvement in national security issues, including his affair with a suspected Chinese spy, the billions of dollars’ worth of advanced Nvidia chips that have been allegedly smuggled despite the government’s export controls, and the fact that the President assured the Nvidia board that his administration does not believe that Jensen is a threat to national security and that he also was not facing any criminal charges, despite ongoing investigations. People also raised questions about the White House’s influence on the board of directors of a private company, something that was characterized as “an unprecedented campaign.”Trump’s push for Jensen Huang’s return at Nvidia is inherently risky, with the president himself saying that he had consulted Attorney General Todd Blanche and Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton about it. He said that they’ve been studying the issue for quite some time and that they had found nothing wrong, especially as Trump said that he can’t have anyone indicted after making the recommendation.
